Package es.uib.lotery.connection

Class BaseClientConnection

java.lang.Object
es.uib.lotery.connection.BaseClientConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientConnection
public class BaseClientConnection extends Object implements ClientConnection
The BaseClientConnection class provides a low-level client-side socket connection for sending and receiving BasePacket objects.

This class implements ClientConnection and manages a non-blocking SocketChannel, encoding packets into a ByteBuffer for transmission.

Key responsibilities:

  • Establish a TCP connection to a given server address.
  • Send serialized BasePacket objects.
  • Receive responses from the server and optionally handle them via a callback.
  • Gracefully disconnect and release resources.

Logging is used extensively to track connection and packet events.
